verses.text: [“] When all these things come upon you— the blessings and curses I have set before you— and you call them to mind in all the nations to which the LORD your God has banished you,

xrefs.text: and when they come to their senses in the land to which they were taken, and they repent and plead with You in the land of their captors, saying, ‘We have sinned and done wrong; we have acted wickedly,’
See, I have set before you today life and prosperity, as well as death and disaster.
But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,
See, today I am setting before you a blessing and a curse—

verses.text: and when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey His voice with all your heart and all your soul according to everything I am giving you today,

xrefs.text: “Yet even now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”

but if you return to Me and keep and practice My commandments, then even if your exiles have been banished to the farthest horizon, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place I have chosen as a dwelling for My Name.’
And there you will serve man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.
Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.

verses.text: then He will restore you from captivity and have compassion on you and gather you from all the nations to which the LORD your God has scattered you.

xrefs.text: I will be found by you, declares the LORD, and I will restore you from captivity and gather you from all the nations and places to which I have banished you, declares the LORD. I will restore you to the place from which I sent you into exile.”
For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and I will bring you back into your own land.
The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.

As a shepherd looks for his scattered sheep when he is among the flock, so I will look for My flock. I will rescue them from all the places to which they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.

verses.text: Even if you have been banished to the farthest horizon, He will gather you and return you from there.

xrefs.text: but if you return to Me and keep and practice My commandments, then even if your exiles have been banished to the farthest horizon, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place I have chosen as a dwelling for My Name.’

Then the LORD will scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your fathers have known.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Now I will restore Jacob from captivity and will have compassion on the whole house of Israel, and I will be jealous for My holy name.

On that day the Lord will extend His hand a second time to recover the remnant of His people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth—

verses.text: And the LORD your God will bring you into the land your fathers possessed, and you will take possession of it. He will cause you to prosper and multiply more than your fathers.

xrefs.text: I will be found by you, declares the LORD, and I will restore you from captivity and gather you from all the nations and places to which I have banished you, declares the LORD. I will restore you to the place from which I sent you into exile.”

verses.text: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.

xrefs.text: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and stiffen your necks no more.
I will give them one heart and one way, so that they will always fear Me for their own good and for the good of their children after them.
And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them; I will remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh,
In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.

verses.text: Then the LORD your God will put all these curses upon your enemies who hate you and persecute you.

xrefs.text: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.
So rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz. Yet the cup will pass to you as well; you will get drunk and expose yourself.
Before your very eyes I will repay Babylon and all the dwellers of Chaldea for all the evil they have done in Zion,” declares the LORD.
This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because Edom acted vengefully against the house of Judah, and in so doing incurred grievous guilt,
Now I am going back to my people, but come, let me warn you what this people will do to your people in the days to come.”

verses.text: And you will again obey the voice of the LORD and follow all His commandments I am giving you today.

xrefs.text: And I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances.
and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross, by which He put to death their hostility.
And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them; I will remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh,
My servant David will be king over them, and there will be one shepherd for all of them. They will follow My ordinances and keep and observe My statutes.

“But this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the LORD. I will put My law in their minds and inscribe it on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.

verses.text: So the LORD your God will make you abound in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land. Indeed, the LORD will again delight in your prosperity, as He delighted in that of your fathers,

xrefs.text: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly— in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land— in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
Yes, I will rejoice in doing them good, and I will faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and with all My soul.
The fruit of your womb will be blessed, as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock— the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

So this city will bring Me renown, joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear of all the good I do for it. They will tremble in awe because of all the goodness and prosperity that I will provide for it.
I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.

verses.text: if you obey the LORD your God by keeping His commandments and statutes that are written in this Book of the Law, and if you turn to Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

xrefs.text: Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
And you will again obey the voice of the LORD and follow all His commandments I am giving you today.

but if you return to Me and keep and practice My commandments, then even if your exiles have been banished to the farthest horizon, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place I have chosen as a dwelling for My Name.’
Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. Keeping God’s commandments is what counts.

verses.text: For this commandment I give you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.

xrefs.text: I have not spoken in secret, from a place in a land of darkness. I did not say to the descendants of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in a wasteland.’ I, the LORD, speak the truth; I say what is right.
He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
Now to Him who is able to strengthen you by my gospel and by the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery concealed for ages past
the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.

verses.text: It is not in heaven, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will ascend into heaven to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’

xrefs.text: But the righteousness that is by faith says: “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down)

Who has ascended to heaven and come down? Who has gathered the wind in His hands? Who has bound up the waters in His cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is His name, and what is the name of His Son— surely you know!
No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven— the Son of Man.

verses.text: And it is not beyond the sea, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will cross the sea to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’

xrefs.text: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from evil.
For wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire compares with her.
How then can they call on the One in whom they have not believed? And how can they believe in the One of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone to preach?
Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.
The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.

verses.text: But the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may obey it.

xrefs.text: But what does it say? “The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart,” that is, the word of faith we are proclaiming:
You planted them, and they have taken root. They have grown and produced fruit. You are ever on their lips, but far from their hearts.
If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord, will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
‘Even the dust of your town that clings to our feet, we wipe off as a testimony against you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God is near.

verses.text: See, I have set before you today life and prosperity, as well as death and disaster.

xrefs.text: See, today I am setting before you a blessing and a curse—
I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,
Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”
And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
[“] When all these things come upon you— the blessings and curses I have set before you— and you call them to mind in all the nations to which the LORD your God has banished you,

verses.text: For I am commanding you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments, statutes, and ordinances, so that you may live and increase, and the LORD your God may bless you in the land that you are entering to possess.

xrefs.text: Jesus declared, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.
By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.

verses.text: But if your heart turns away and you do not listen, but are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,

xrefs.text: For the waywardness of the simple will slay them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.
So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.

See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?

Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the LORD our God to go and worship the gods of those nations. Make sure there is no root among you that bears such poisonous and bitter fruit,

verses.text: I declare to you today that you will surely perish; you shall not prolong your days in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.

xrefs.text: If you ever forget the LORD your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.

But just as every good thing the LORD your God promised you has come to pass, likewise the LORD will bring upon you the calamity He has threatened, until He has destroyed you from this good land He has given you.
Why, O LORD, do You make us stray from Your ways and harden our hearts from fearing You? Return, for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your heritage.

I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live long upon it, but will be utterly destroyed.

For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt and turn from the path I have commanded you. And in the days to come, disaster will befall you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger by the work of your hands.”

verses.text: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,

xrefs.text: See, I have set before you today life and prosperity, as well as death and disaster.
See, today I am setting before you a blessing and a curse—
I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.

But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”
But he who fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death.”

verses.text: and that you may love the LORD your God, obey Him, and hold fast to Him. For He is your life, and He will prolong your life in the land that the LORD swore to give to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”

xrefs.text: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
You are to fear the LORD your God and serve Him. Hold fast to Him and take your oaths in His name.
Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
